substantive_reconstruction.dilation_and_clean_block: Let S=sqrt(I-Sigma^2). Both real diagonal matrices commute, S^2+Sigma^2=I and M†=M. Therefore M^2 has diagonal blocks I and offdiagonal commutators0. The outer block diagonals are unitary, so their product is unitary. Full multiplication gives U_A=[[W Sigma V†,W S],[S V†,-Sigma]], hence the clean0-to0 block is exactly A, with ancilla preceding the system as stated. This holds for every finite N=2^n, including N=1.
substantive_reconstruction.branch_and_kernel: For ||b||=1, the output is |0>Ab+|1>S V†b. Orthogonal ancilla sectors give p_b=||Ab||^2 and1-p_b=||S V†b||^2. The normalized successful vector is Ab/sqrt(p_b) only when p_b>0. If Ab=0 the outcome never occurs, not a zero physical state or an arbitrary automatically defined conditional vector. A=0 has no defined normalized target on any normalized input. No success-probability denominator is suppressed.
substantive_reconstruction.norm_one_subspace: H=I-A†A is positive semidefinite. For a normalized b, p_b=1 iff <b,Hb>=||sqrt(H)b||^2=0 iff Hb0. This is K=ker(I-A†A), the span of right singular vectors with singular value1. Inner products are preserved on K because A†A acts as I there. For A=diag(1,1/2), b=|0> belongs to K although A is nonunitary. Thus even the chosen branch need not be probabilistic for every input of a nonunitary A; cI has the contrasting K={0}.
substantive_reconstruction.normalized_counterexample_quantifiers: For any fixed real c with0<c<1 and every normalized b, cIb is nonzero and cIb/||cIb||=b exactly. The identity on the original system produces this normalized vector deterministically, with no extra register or postselection. The displayed unit-factor dilation still succeeds with probability c^2. That difference is allowed because the identity does not preserve the c amplitude as an unnormalized linear operator. One universal counterexample family refutes necessity for ALL normalized-target procedures; it does not prove arbitrary nonlinear normalization is a deterministic channel.
substantive_reconstruction.exact_operator_and_density_branch: If a system unitary equals A on every input, equality of the linear maps gives A†A=I; square finite dimension then implies A is unitary. A nonunitary square contraction has a singular value below1 and cannot equal such a norm-preserving map. Separately tr(A rho A†)=tr(rho A†A) is1 for every density iff A†A=I: testing all rank-one projectors annihilates the Hermitian quadratic form A†A-I, hence the matrix. Conversely that identity makes the branch TP (and square-unitary). As a contraction it is always CP trace-nonincreasing, but not a deterministic trace-one branch when nonunitary. Its normalized conditional density is a different expression, undefined at zero trace.
substantive_reconstruction.implementation_boundary: The SVD construction proves finite-dimensional existence of a dilation, not efficient SVD access, state preparation of arbitrary b, a one-/two-qubit gate compilation, finite-bit arithmetic, a generic deterministic normalized-state map or a new formal certificate. The candidate preserves the source's efficiency caveat and does not replace the branch with an implementation of cI as a system-only exact operator.
